activityname.description: Name of the activity that is being executed.

completedon.description: Date and time when the dialog session was completed.

createdon.description: Date and time when the dialog session was created.

errorcode.description: Error code related to the dialog session.

executedon.description: Date and time when the dialog process was run.

startedon.description: Date and time when the dialog session was started.
